title: C++ Loops
description: while, for, do-while and range-for, plus the break, continue and boundary rules that keep a loop correct.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: while、for、do-while 與 range-for，以及讓迴圈保持正確的 break、continue 與邊界規則。

questions.prompt: Which loop always executes its body at least once?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一種迴圈至少一定會執行一次迴圈本體？

explanation.zh-Hant: do-while 先執行本體再檢查條件；while 與 for 都在第一次執行前檢查條件，可能一次也不執行。

questions.explanation: do-while runs the body first and then tests the condition. while and for test before the first iteration, so their body may never run.

questions.prompt: How many times does the body of `for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i)` execute?

prompt.zh-Hant: `for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i)` 的本體會執行多少次？

explanation.zh-Hant: i 依序為 0、1、2、3、4，共 5 次；當 i 變成 5 時條件 5 < 5 為假，迴圈結束。

questions.explanation: i takes the values 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4: five iterations. When i becomes 5 the condition 5 < 5 is false and the loop ends.

questions.prompt: Which loop visits every element of `std::vector<int> v` without copying each element and without reading out of bounds?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個迴圈走訪 `std::vector<int> v` 的每個元素、不複製元素，且不會越界讀取？

explanation.zh-Hant: range-for 搭配 const auto& 會以參考走訪，避免複製；`auto x` 會逐個複製，`i <= size` 會越界，`while (v)` 根本不是合法條件。

questions.explanation: A range-for with `const auto&` binds a reference to each element and avoids copies. `auto x` copies, `i <= v.size()` reads one past the end, and `while (v)` is not a valid condition.

questions.prompt: What does `break` do inside a loop?

prompt.zh-Hant: `break` 在迴圈中的作用是甚麼？

a.zh-Hant: 立即離開最接近的迴圈或 switch

b.zh-Hant: 跳過本次迭代，繼續下一次

explanation.zh-Hant: break 終止最內層的迴圈或 switch；跳過本次迭代是 continue，結束程式是 return 或 std::exit。

options.text: Exit the nearest enclosing loop or switch immediately
Skip the rest of this iteration and continue with the next
Restart the loop from the beginning

questions.explanation: break leaves the innermost loop or switch. Skipping one iteration is continue; ending the program is return or std::exit.

questions.prompt: Which of these are loop statements in C++? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是 C++ 的迴圈敘述？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: C++ 提供 for、while、do-while（以及 range-for）；repeat-until 是其他語言的語法。

questions.explanation: C++ has for, while and do-while (plus range-for). repeat-until is not C++ syntax.

questions.prompt: Which statements about `continue` are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 關於 `continue`，下列敘述何者正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 它會跳過本體中剩餘的敘述。

b.zh-Hant: 在 for 迴圈中，它之後仍會執行遞增敘述。

d.zh-Hant: 它與 break 完全相同。

explanation.zh-Hant: continue 只跳過本次迭代剩下的部分，然後進入下一次迭代；for 的遞增部分仍會執行，break 則直接離開迴圈。

options.text: It skips the rest of the loop body.
In a for loop, the increment still runs afterwards.
It does not terminate the loop.

questions.explanation: continue skips the rest of the current iteration and moves to the next one. In a for loop the increment expression still runs; break leaves the loop entirely.

questions.prompt: `for (;;)` is an infinite loop unless the body breaks out or returns.

prompt.zh-Hant: 除非本體中有 break 或 return，否則 `for (;;)` 是無限迴圈。

explanation.zh-Hant: for 的三個部分都可省略；條件省略代表永遠為真，因此若沒有 break 或 return 就會一直執行。

questions.explanation: All three parts of a for header may be omitted. An omitted condition is always true, so the loop runs forever unless the body breaks or returns.

questions.prompt: A `break` inside a nested loop exits every enclosing loop at once.

prompt.zh-Hant: 巢狀迴圈中的 `break` 會一次跳出所有外層迴圈。

explanation.zh-Hant: break 只離開最內層的迴圈；要離開多層迴圈需要旗標、goto 或重構。

questions.explanation: break only leaves the innermost loop. Leaving several levels needs a flag, goto, or a refactor.

questions.prompt: A for loop that visits each element of a range without an index is called a ____-based for loop.

prompt.zh-Hant: 不需索引、逐一走訪範圍每個元素的 for 迴圈稱為 ____ 式 for 迴圈。

explanation.zh-Hant: range-for 會自動走訪整個範圍，例如 `for (const auto& x : v)`。

questions.explanation: A range-based for loop walks the whole range automatically, as in `for (const auto& x : v)`.

questions.prompt: Explain what an off-by-one error is in a loop and how to avoid it.

prompt.zh-Hant: 說明迴圈中的「差一錯誤」（off-by-one）是甚麼，以及如何避免。

model.zh-Hant: 差一錯誤是邊界判斷寫錯，例如把 `i < n` 寫成 `i <= n`，導致多執行一次或越界。避免方法是先確定區間是半開還是閉合、用 `< size()` 走訪容器，並用 range-for 取代手動索引。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵在於清楚定義「包含起點、不包含終點」的習慣，並讓容器自己提供大小。

answer.model: An off-by-one error is a boundary mistake such as writing `i <= n` when the valid indices are 0..n-1, which runs one extra iteration or reads out of bounds. Avoid it by deciding whether the range is half-open, using `i < v.size()` for containers, and preferring range-for when the index is not needed.

questions.explanation: The key is to define half-open ranges consistently and let the container supply its size.
